         q.expected, q.actual, q.checked_at_utc, q.code_revision,
         regexp_replace(q.check_name, '^[^:]+: ', '') AS check_key
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results AS q
),

  SELECT r.*,
         COALESCE(e.quality_attribute, b.quality_attribute, f.quality_attribute, 'Unclassified') AS quality_attribute,
         COALESCE(e.check_kind, b.check_kind, f.check_kind, 'test') AS check_kind,
         CASE WHEN e.check_key IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE('deliberately unclassified: ' || e.note, 'listed')
              WHEN b.check_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'listed, with a year or concept qualifier'
              WHEN f.check_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'name family ' || f.check_key
              ELSE 'not in config/quality_attributes.yml' END AS classification_basis
  FROM results AS r
  LEFT JOIN catalog AS e ON e.match_kind = 'name' AND e.check_key = r.check_key
  LEFT JOIN catalog AS b ON b.match_kind = 'name' AND e.check_key IS NULL
    AND b.check_key = regexp_replace(r.check_key, '_([0-9]{4}|household|total)$', '') AND b.check_key <> r.check_key
  LEFT JOIN catalog AS f ON f.match_kind = 'family' AND e.check_key IS NULL AND b.check_key IS NULL
    AND LEFT(r.check_key, LENGTH(f.check_key)) = f.check_key
),
newest AS (
  SELECT c.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.layer, c.source_id, c.table_name, c.check_name, c.batch_id
                           ORDER BY c.checked_at_utc DESC) AS result_rank
  FROM classified AS c
),
batches AS (
  SELECT b.batch_id, b.status AS batch_status, COALESCE(b.school_year, b.logical_dataset) AS batch_period,
         cb.batch_id IS NOT NULL AS is_current_batch
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.ingestion_batches AS b
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`01-control`.current_batches AS cb ON cb.batch_id = b.batch_id
),
snapshot AS (
  SELECT n.*, bt.batch_period,
         CASE WHEN n.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'not batch-scoped'
              WHEN bt.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'not in ingestion_batches'
              WHEN bt.is_current_batch THEN 'current delivery'
              ELSE 'batch ' || bt.batch_status END AS batch_state
  FROM newest AS n
  LEFT JOIN batches AS bt ON bt.batch_id = n.batch_id
  WHERE n.result_rank = 1
    -- A delivery replaced by a newer version is no longer read downstream.
    AND NOT COALESCE(bt.batch_status = 'succeeded' AND NOT bt.is_current_batch, FALSE)
)
SELECT layer, source_id, table_name, check_name, status, expected, actual,
       quality_attribute, check_kind, classification_basis,
       run_id, batch_id, batch_period, batch_state, checked_at_utc AS last_checked_at_utc, code_revision,
       CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pass,
       CASE WHEN status = 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_warn,
       CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fail,
       1 AS is_result,
       CASE WHEN check_kind = 'test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_test,
       CASE WHEN check_kind = 'test' AND status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_test_pass
FROM snapshot

columns.description: PASS / (PASS + WARN + FAIL) over current results of tests; recorded counts are left out. Empty when there is no test result.

datasets.name: ds_history
queryLines:
-- History: every recorded result in the date range. Counts result events, not checks.
SELECT q.layer, q.source_id, q.table_name, q.check_name, q.status, q.expected, q.actual,
       q.run_id, q.batch_id, q.checked_at_utc, q.code_revision
FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results AS q
WHERE CAST(q.checked_at_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN :history_range.min AND :history_range.max

datasets.name: ds_runs
queryLines:
-- One row per job run. A Bronze load records its own run_id and the job run in job_run_id;
-- its gate, and every other gate, write results under the job run. So both sides are
-- aggregated to that id before the join, and nothing is counted twice.
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(job_run_id, run_id) AS run_id,
         MAX(environment) AS environment,
         MIN(started_at_utc) AS started_at_utc,
         CASE WHEN COUNT_IF(finished_at_utc IS NULL) = 0 THEN MAX(finished_at_utc) END AS finished_at_utc,
         COUNT(*) AS steps,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'failed') AS failed_steps,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'running') AS unfinished_steps,
         string_agg(CASE WHEN status <> 'succeeded' THEN pipeline_name || ' ' || source_id END, ', ') AS steps_not_succeeded,
         string_agg(DISTINCT failure_stage, ', ') AS failure_stages,
         max_by(error_message, COALESCE(finished_at_utc, started_at_utc)) AS last_error_message,
         string_agg(DISTINCT code_revision, ', ') AS code_revisions
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.pipeline_runs
  GROUP BY COALESCE(job_run_id, run_id)
),
checks AS (
  SELECT run_id, COUNT_IF(status = 'PASS') AS pass_results, COUNT_IF(status = 'WARN') AS warn_results,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL') AS fail_results, MIN(checked_at_utc) AS first_checked_at_utc
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results
  GROUP BY run_id
),
joined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(r.run_id, c.run_id) AS run_id, r.environment,
         CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no pipeline_runs row'
              WHEN r.failed_steps > 0 THEN 'failed'
              WHEN r.unfinished_steps > 0 THEN 'running or interrupted'
              ELSE 'succeeded' END AS run_status,
         COALESCE(r.started_at_utc, c.first_checked_at_utc) AS run_started_at_utc,
         r.finished_at_utc AS run_finished_at_utc,
         timestampdiff(SECOND, r.started_at_utc, r.finished_at_utc) / 60.0 AS duration_minutes,
         r.steps, r.failed_steps, r.steps_not_succeeded, r.failure_stages,
         LEFT(r.last_error_message, 300) AS last_error_message, r.code_revisions,
         COALESCE(c.pass_results, 0) AS pass_results, COALESCE(c.warn_results, 0) AS warn_results,
         COALESCE(c.fail_results, 0) AS fail_results
  FROM runs AS r
  FULL OUTER JOIN checks AS c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
)
SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY run_started_at_utc DESC) AS run_recency
FROM joined

datasets.name: ds_freshness
queryLines:
-- The rows the stale_sources alert reads: the latest run that checked freshness, newest
-- result per source, with the source's latest succeeded delivery beside it.
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results
  WHERE check_name = 'source_fresh'
  ORDER BY checked_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
),
newest AS (
  SELECT q.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY q.source_id ORDER BY q.checked_at_utc DESC) AS result_rank
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results AS q
  JOIN latest_run AS r ON q.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE q.check_name = 'source_fresh'
),
delivered AS (
  SELECT source_id, MAX(succeeded_at_utc) AS last_succeeded_at_utc, COUNT(*) AS current_batches
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.current_batches
  GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT n.source_id, n.status AS freshness_status, n.expected AS freshness_limit,
       n.actual AS freshness_observed, n.checked_at_utc AS freshness_checked_at_utc, n.run_id,
       d.last_succeeded_at_utc, d.current_batches,
       CASE WHEN n.status = 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_stale
FROM newest AS n
LEFT JOIN delivered AS d ON d.source_id = n.source_id
WHERE n.result_rank = 1

datasets.name: ds_layers
queryLines:
-- Every pipeline layer, with or without results, and any other layer a gate recorded.
WITH recorded AS (
  SELECT layer, COUNT(*) AS result_events, COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS runs,
         COUNT(DISTINCT check_name) AS distinct_checks, MAX(checked_at_utc) AS last_checked_at_utc
  FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results
  GROUP BY layer
)
SELECT COALESCE(l.layer, r.layer) AS layer, COALESCE(l.layer_order, 99) AS layer_order,
       CASE WHEN r.layer IS NULL THEN 'No checks recorded yet'
            WHEN l.layer IS NULL THEN 'Checks recorded (layer not in the pipeline list)'
            ELSE 'Checks recorded' END AS coverage_state,
       r.result_events, r.runs, r.distinct_checks, r.last_checked_at_utc
FROM (VALUES (1, 'control'), (2, 'bronze'), (3, 'silver'), (4, 'integration'), (5, 'gold'), (6, 'analytics')) AS l(layer_order, layer)
FULL OUTER JOIN recorded AS r ON r.layer = l.layer

lines:
# Data quality: Education Access Intelligence pipeline

What every gate recorded in `edu_access.01-control.data_quality_results`, with runs from `pipeline_runs` and deliveries from `ingestion_batches`. **Counts are check results, never data rows.** All times are UTC. **Current** widgets show the newest result of each check; **History** widgets count every recorded result in the date range. A layer with no results says so, it is not shown as passing. Definitions are at the bottom of this page.

frame.title: Current checks
frame.description: Results in the current view (tests and recorded counts). Empty: nothing recorded yet.

frame.title: Pass rate (tests)
frame.description: PASS / (PASS + WARN + FAIL) of current tests, recorded counts left out. Not a data-quality score.

frame.title: Stale-source WARNs
frame.description: source_fresh WARNs in the latest freshness check, the rows the stale_sources alert emails

frame.title: Latest job run
frame.description: The run that started last (pipeline_runs rolled up to the job run). Result counts are that run's events only.

frame.title: Current results by layer
frame.description: Current results: the newest result of each check, from whichever run checked it last. Counts are check results, not data rows. A layer with no results is absent here; see Layer coverage.

frame.title: Layer coverage
frame.description: Every pipeline layer. 'No checks recorded yet' means no gate of that layer has written a result: not built or not run, never a pass. Gold and Analytics gates are placeholders until they are implemented.

frame.title: Current results by source
frame.description: Current results: the newest result of each check, from whichever run checked it last. Counts are check results, not data rows. An empty source is a layer-wide check with no source_id.

frame.title: Current results by quality attribute
frame.description: From config/quality_attributes.yml. An attribute missing here has no check, which is not a pass. Unclassified checks stay visible; Recorded count is evidence, always PASS.

frame.title: History: check-result events per day (UTC)
frame.description: Every recorded result in the date range. A check that ran in three runs is three events, so this is activity and direction, not the number of checks.

frame.title: Source freshness (current)
frame.description: Latest source_fresh check, as the stale_sources alert reads it. Limits come from config/freshness.yml; a WARN means check the publisher, not that data is wrong.

frame.title: Job runs (history)
frame.description: Runs that started in the date range. A Bronze load's own run is rolled up to its job run. 'no pipeline_runs row' means results exist under a run id with no run record.

frame.title: Quarantine against the 1% limit (current)
frame.description: Silver quarantine_rate per delivery: WARN above 0, FAIL above 1% of that year's Bronze rows. Expected and actual are shown as recorded.

frame.title: Integration and PSGC map checks (current)
frame.description: Match outcomes, review state, and match rate as each Integration gate records them. Only the HDX map records a match_rate_percent so far.

lines:
### Definitions

**PASS** as expected. **WARN** worth knowing, not necessarily wrong (for example rows quarantined within the limit, a stale source); the batch or build stands. **FAIL** the batch or build is not trusted: a Bronze batch is not marked succeeded, a Silver or Integration candidate is not published, and the gate task fails.

**Current** is one row per (layer, source, table, check, batch): its newest result. Results of a delivery replaced by a newer version are left out; a failed or blocked delivery stays until it is retried. A check no gate runs any more keeps its last result, with its date.

**Pass rate (tests)** = PASS / (PASS + WARN + FAIL) over current tests. *Recorded counts* (how many rows a cleaning rule changed, matches per method, row kinds) are always PASS and left out. It is empty, not 0% or 100%, when there is no test result.

**Quality attributes**: Completeness, Uniqueness, Validity, Accuracy, Consistency, Timeliness, Referential integrity, Reconciliation, Lineage. Assigned in config/quality_attributes.yml; a check it does not list is **Unclassified**, shown, and covers no attribute.

## Check explorer

Find a WARN or FAIL and trace it to its run, batch, and code revision. Status starts at WARN and FAIL; add PASS to compare. Results hold counts and rules, never row values. Times are UTC.

frame.title: History: every result event in the date range
frame.description: Each row is one recorded result. The same check appears once per run (and batch) that ran it, so a check that keeps warning shows once per run.

frame.title: Current: newest result of each check
frame.description: Not date-filtered. One row per (layer, source, table, check, batch).

frame.title: Date range (UTC)
frame.description: History and runs; default the last 90 days. Current results are not date-filtered.
